metadata.description: Rajib Bahar's Claude Code plugins: staff-kit (engineering standards, skills, agents, guards) market-watch (live market data in the session) and snowflake-delivery (Snowflake labs, semantic views, SnowDDL, releases), plus vendored third-party plugins (threejs, cert-safari-quiz, evolv-taste-pilot).

plugins.name: staff-kit
plugins.description: Staff-level engineering standards: 43 skills, 23 model-routed agents, 15 commands, 19 rules, tiered contexts, and a destructive-ops guard hook. Snowflake, dbt, SQL, and cost-disciplined multi-agent work.

plugins.name: snowflake-delivery
plugins.description: Snowflake delivery work, made generic: hands-on-lab setup/seed/verify/teardown with a teardown checker, semantic view and Cortex Agent authoring, SnowDDL review, Cortex Code demo skills, an MCP server scaffold, and regression-proof plugin releases.

plugins.name: market-watch
plugins.description: Stock ticker in the status line, /quote pane, price alerts, a market-context band, and a quote tool the model can call.

plugins.name: strategy-card
plugins.description: Draft, validate and badge a one-page disclosure card for a backtest. Analysis only: no orders, no brokers, no network. Not investment advice.

plugins.name: test-tamper-guard
plugins.description: Analysis-only guard: asks before an edit that weakens a test (skip/xfail, loosened tolerance, deleted test, changed expectation). Never edits files or runs your code.

plugins.name: api-reality-check
plugins.description: After each Write/Edit of a .py file, checks that its imports, attributes and keyword arguments exist in your installed library versions. Analysis only; never modifies files.

plugins.name: sharpe-observatory
plugins.description: Screen a stock universe by Sharpe ratio and Jensen's alpha with a multiple-testing luck correction (Probabilistic and Deflated Sharpe), then render a 3D skyline. Offline sample data by default; not investment advice.

plugins.name: quant-rigor
plugins.description: Statistical rigour for quant research: tested Sharpe, PSR, DSR, Holm, Diebold-Mariano and purged walk-forward splits; a seal-then-score-once holdout; a procedure-attacking research auditor; reproducible market data fetch with a SHA-256 manifest and a DoltHub read-only guard.

plugins.name: threejs
plugins.description: Third-party (Tony Turner). Ten grounded three.js r185 skills: scene setup, glTF, materials/lighting, performance, picking, animation, post-processing, debugging, WebGPU/TSL.

plugins.name: cert-safari-quiz
plugins.description: Third-party (Tony Turner). CCA-F practice quiz: 100 scenario questions, confidence ratings, spaced repetition.

plugins.name: evolv-taste-pilot
plugins.description: Third-party (evolv Consulting, MIT). Executable frontend ship gate: 27 source checks and 9 rendered checks, with the taste-precedence overlay.
